card.name: Morphing Jar
card.officialText: FLIP: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws 5 cards.

design.scope: Isolated TagDuel adapter/test/evidence/workflow; no central resolver or catalog registration.
design.trigger: Only a real Flip Summon event; normal summon/effect-flip are rejected.
design.discard: Both active team hands are moved intact to their respective team Graveyards before either team draws.
design.draw: Each active team draws up to five from its current representative Deck; fewer than five is a failed draw. Both failures in the same simultaneous resolution produce a draw; one failure awards the other team.
design.ownership: CardRefs and physical UIDs remain unchanged; inactive partner reserve hands/decks are untouched; stolen Morphing Jar resolves for its controller team.
design.idempotency: Required activationId is persisted in JSON; replay is rejected, including after negation.
design.safety: Temporary state fixtures only; no inventory grants, player DB, catalog, resolver, manifest, allowlist or live Discord writes.
